sources.title: MC Press — Working with System Values (subset by type)

notes: WRKSYSVAL may show 'Subset by type' prompt on entry; subfile lists Opt, System value, Value, Category. SYSVAL(*SEC) filters security values.
asciiPanel:
WRKSYSVAL                        Work with System Values                 CLAIMS400

Type options, press Enter.
  2=Change   5=Display

Opt  System value    Value                     Category
     QSECURITY       40                        Security
     QAUDCTL         *NONE                     Security
     QMAXSIGN        5                         Security
     QINACTITV       30                        Security
                                            More...

Parameters or command
===>
F3=Exit  F5=Refresh  F7=Page up  F8=Page down  F12=Cancel
